newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen rebounding after two-day fall.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen rebounding after two-day fall.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rebound after a two-session fall on the back of strong buying after price fixing and most stocks trading higher in the post-fixing continuous trade than at the regular session.
Analysts said, however, they saw no strong upside potential and expected the market to stay in its seven week-horizontal trend in longer term.

Some analysts said banks, which underperformed the market in the last over two months migh start bottoming in the next few sessions and expected BPH and BRE rises on Friday. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
